excerpt.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
excerpt.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

texts.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
texts.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

sections.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
sections.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一座传感阵列，孤零零的俯瞰着[From.GetName]。这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有任何值得一提的智慧生物，所以这一定是座被遗弃的哨站。它的年代不算久远，但却无法使用了。

我们需要修理并研究它才能让它恢复运作，不过要是拆毁它也许能够让我们学习到新的技术。
texts.en:
We have found a sensor array, solemnly standing watch on [From.GetName]. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has no sapient life to speak of, so it must be an abandoned outpost. It was built recently, but is not functioning.

It would require both repairs and research to bring it back into working condition, while breaking it apart could allow us to learn something new from it.

label.zh: 不管它，也许它的主人会归来。
label.en: Leave it alone in case the owner returns.

texts.zh: 一座被遗弃的传感器阵列似乎处于工作状态。如果我们能修复它并弄清楚它是如何工作的，我们也许能获得更多周边星系的详细信息。
texts.en: An abandoned sensor dish seems to be in working condition. If we perform some repairs and figure out how it functions we might be able to gain more insight into neighboring systems.

texts.zh: 数个月的工作终于开花结果了！[From.From.From.GetName]的传感阵列再一次恢复了运作，现在我们在附近一带的扫描范围更大了。不过传感阵列需要更多的能量和人力才能正常运行，所以我们需要建立一个殖民地来维持它。
texts.en: Months of work have finally paid off! The sensor array on [From.From.From.GetName] is once again functioning and it appears to be able to give us a vastly improved sensor range of the nearby area. However, the array needs more energy and personnel to work, so a colony is needed in order to supply it with energy.

tooltips.zh: 添加高级传感阵列修正到[From.From.From.GetName]。
tooltips.en: Adds the Superior Sensor Array modifier to [From.From.From.GetName].

tooltips.zh:
解锁广泛传感器搜寻帝国法令。

添加高级传感阵列修正到[From.From.From.GetName]。
tooltips.en:
Gives access to the Extensive Sensor Searches Empire Edict.

Adds the Superior Sensor Array modifier to [From.From.From.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]的修复工程传来坏消息。建筑工人未能修理坏掉的机器，机器开始自行解体，已经无法修理了。
texts.en: Bad news from the repairs project on [From.From.From.GetName]. The construction workers have not been able to fix the broken machine, as it has started to break down even further and seems to be beyond repair.
